objects_and_invariants.title: Creator ownership, schema/object grants and RLS
objects_and_invariants.mechanism: One reviewed Prisma SQL history plus separately fingerprinted environment role prerequisite
objects_and_invariants.exact_requirement: All app/platform tables owned by wa_schema_owner NOLOGIN/NOBYPASSRLS; ENABLE+FORCE RLS. No schema USAGE/CREATE or object/table/sequence/function grants to anon/authenticated/service_role for internal objects. No TRUNCATE/REFERENCES/TRIGGER/MAINTAIN/CREATE/SET ROLE to application/worker. All actual application DDL must SET ROLE wa_schema_owner; migration ledger exception is private and migrator-owned. Global function default PUBLIC EXECUTE revoked for new application creator roles; no broad changes to provider roles/defaults. Inventory all roles capable of SET ROLE/inheriting the owner. Reject catalog owner/default-ACL drift.
objects_and_invariants.positive_test: Exact runtime/worker positive action passes its registered policy; migrator installs without giving runtime ownership
objects_and_invariants.negative_test: Anonymous/authenticated/service-role direct app/platform CRUD denied; runtime TRUNCATE/DDL/SET ROLE denied

objects_and_invariants.title: Immutable transaction context and row/field scope
objects_and_invariants.mechanism: Issuer-committed transaction tuple plus read-only helper and operation-specific RLS
objects_and_invariants.exact_requirement: A custom actor-ID GUC is never authority. A 256-bit secret handle hashes to an issuer-written DatabaseActionGrant. Open a READ COMMITTED interactive transaction on one physical runtime/worker connection; before any business read or source lock, capture session_user, pg_backend_pid() and pg_current_xact_id()::text through the trusted server bridge, never client input. The separately credentialed issuer rechecks SH-001/SH-002/source-owner action, target, field and currentness authorization and commits a grant with that NONNULL immutable login/PID/xid8 tuple in its own separate transaction. Only after that issuer COMMIT may the source transaction bind the handle. The helper is read-only on the grant table: compare the full tuple and purpose/action/owner/target, subject-or-service XOR, expiry/revocation and current security/source generations; reject NULL binding or non-READ-COMMITTED isolation. No bind-time grant UPDATE, consumption flag or autonomous transaction is assumed. Full ROLLBACK, rollback to a SAVEPOINT containing the bind, failed bind, and commit cannot undo the separately committed tuple. An old token therefore cannot authorize a later transaction, even on the same pooled backend; a new transaction requires fresh authorization and a new grant. Rebinding within the same live transaction is idempotent and does not widen scope. SET LOCAL carries only the opaque handle. Current source/Consent/entitlement/Hold/proof, RLS USING/WITH CHECK and column/field guards remain required. There is no issuer/provider/network call while source locks are held. Revocation is irreversible; currentness is rechecked at protected effects and commit under the source-specific locking protocol. Current service authority is a private Identity-owned generation/revocation record bound to an immutable Identity receipt. Issuer cannot write or manufacture that source; absent/revoked/stale source denies. Actual action/purpose/root is enforced through protected_scope and context_allows, not just field tokens.
objects_and_invariants.positive_test: Issuer commits an authorized tuple grant before bind; named runtime and worker helper paths succeed only in that transaction
objects_and_invariants.negative_test: Full rollback, SAVEPOINT rollback, failed bind, old pooled token, wrong tuple/isolation, stale generation, forged actor and direct grant writes all fail closed

objects_and_invariants.title: Immutable identity, state vocabulary and UTC
objects_and_invariants.exact_requirement: Primary and owning FK identities cannot be reassigned. Every mapped FK uses RESTRICT for key update/deletion; Privacy must act explicitly. Mutable source revision advances exactly once through compare-and-swap. Generation/fence cannot decrease. Time intervals require end > start; supported states are source-specific. Enum existence never authorizes a legacy/deferred transition. UTC instants use timestamptz(6); local availability separately carries IANA timezone.
objects_and_invariants.positive_test: Authorized source update increments expected revision and preserves identity
objects_and_invariants.negative_test: Stale competing revision, negative generation, swapped owner or invalid interval denied

objects_and_invariants.title: Retained evidence and scoped Privacy redaction
objects_and_invariants.mechanism: Append/content-immutability triggers and separately authorized field redaction
objects_and_invariants.exact_requirement: Immutable content/semantic columns on consent, source/effect histories, signatures, document/object revisions, provider occurrences and fiscal/points/usage ledgers cannot be rewritten or cascade-deleted. Correct via linked immutable evidence. A lawful Privacy action may redact only its approved field map under a current request/instruction/generation and durable receipt; legal retention policy is external. Never treat immutable as a blanket refusal of statutory erasure.
objects_and_invariants.positive_test: New correction/history/qualified minimization receipt can be appended without changing old semantic effect
objects_and_invariants.negative_test: Direct UPDATE/DELETE of proof core, parent cascade and unreviewed blanket retention/deletion denied

objects_and_invariants.title: Exact content/presentation/subject/action/context proof
objects_and_invariants.mechanism: Composite user/content/presentation FK plus immutable proof and null-safe action/context coherence
objects_and_invariants.exact_requirement: ConsentPresentation is an immutable per-user, per-action presentation: required userId references User; actionOwner/action and contextOwner/contextKind/contextId describe the exact authorized presentation, not a reusable public template. ConsentLog (presentationId, contentRevisionId, userId) has a restrictive composite FK to ConsentPresentation (id, contentRevisionId, userId), backed by the corresponding unique key. SQL checks also require equal actionOwner, action, contextOwner and contextKind, and contextId IS NOT DISTINCT FROM the presentation contextId; NULL is only allowed for a registered global context, not a wildcard. ConsentLog.presentationHash equals ConsentPresentation.renderedHash. The owner verifies the actually rendered bytes/hash and exact contentRevisionId, type/version, applicability and accepting authenticated User; an FK or submitted hash alone does not prove display or acceptance. Unique (userId, acceptanceKey); the fingerprint covers exact presentation ID/hash/content/user/action/context. Identical replay returns the original proof; changed meaning conflicts and intentional reacceptance uses a new key. Effective intervals are coherent; activated content, presentations and acceptance proofs are immutable. Draft/test-only policy never activates in production. Decline/withdrawal appends ConsentDisposition linked to the same user and presentation (and exact prior proof where supplied); it never erases old proof. No new IP, device, email or other personal metadata is required by this correction.
objects_and_invariants.positive_test: Exact per-user test presentation and acknowledged hash can be accepted and replayed with the same fingerprint
objects_and_invariants.negative_test: Cross-user/content/action/context/hash acceptance, NULL-as-wildcard, proof rewrite and draft production activation denied

objects_and_invariants.title: Read-only private context helpers
objects_and_invariants.mechanism: Narrow SECURITY DEFINER SELECT-only helpers with private owner and pinned search_path
objects_and_invariants.exact_requirement: platform_private.bind_request_context(secret text) returns a grant ID only after validating the issuer-committed immutable login/backend/xid tuple against session_user, pg_backend_pid() and pg_current_xact_id()::text in READ COMMITTED. It SELECTs only the bounded grant columns and minimal Identity generations, then sets transaction-local transport; it never INSERTs, UPDATEs or DELETEs a grant. platform_private.context_allows(owner,action,kind,id,purpose) returns only a Boolean after the same tuple/currentness checks. Both SECURITY DEFINER helpers pin search_path=pg_catalog and qualify every application name. Their NOLOGIN/NOBYPASSRLS owner wa_private_helper_owner has bounded SELECT only, no grant-table write. REVOKE PUBLIC execution; only named runtime/worker (later separately approved privacy) roles receive EXECUTE, never direct grant-table privileges. wa_context_issuer alone may INSERT an already authorized fully bound grant, SELECT its own issued rows and UPDATE revokedAt from NULL to a timestamp; it cannot change any issued scope/tuple or DELETE. Runtime/worker cannot SET ROLE issuer/helper/owner. Issuer credentials remain separate and outside source/logs. Issuance commits after tuple capture and before business reads/source locks; no second connection is used under those locks. Fixed Customer/Track Boolean ports use distinct NOLOGIN read-only roles and the exact columns in foundation-sql-verifier-access.json; direct worker grants remain unchanged. The private helper reads only current service generation/revocation in addition to its original Identity/grant leaves.
objects_and_invariants.positive_test: Issuer-only grant operations and runtime/worker EXECUTE succeed without direct grant access
objects_and_invariants.negative_test: Direct runtime/worker grant CRUD, helper writes/login, issuer scope rewrite and browser helper invocation denied

objects_and_invariants.title: Scoped idempotency and economic effects
objects_and_invariants.owner: platform mechanism; effect meaning remains owner
objects_and_invariants.mechanism: Compound unique constraints and durable fingerprint/result receipts
objects_and_invariants.exact_requirement: Command identity is (ownerModuleId,operation,subjectScope,semanticKey). Economic effect identity is separately (ownerModuleId,operation,subjectScope,semanticEffectKey); inbox identity is (consumerOwner,handlerName,outboxMessageId). Every duplicate preserves the original fingerprint/result; changed fingerprint conflicts. Per-source ledger semanticEffectKey plus typed effectReceiptId binds actual owner/currency/source. Permanent business effects must not depend on short transport retention.
objects_and_invariants.positive_test: Identical replay yields original receipt; different owners/scopes can use their own equal textual key
objects_and_invariants.negative_test: Same scoped key with changed fingerprint or duplicate money/points/usage source effect rejected

objects_and_invariants.title: Atomic source, owner history and outbox
objects_and_invariants.mechanism: Server-stamped transaction IDs and per-source deferred constraint triggers
objects_and_invariants.exact_requirement: All candidate rows have mutationTransactionId stamped by PostgreSQL; caller spoofing rejected. For each registered source mutation, concrete table/PK/revision and owning command receipt must match an OwnerMutationEvidence record in the same transaction. Required domain history and finite registered event/command intents must also match that transaction/source revision. Each source-specific trigger is generated from this ledger after approval, uses fixed identifiers and SECURITY INVOKER; no generic source repository/dynamic caller SQL. For Customer creation require CustomerProfileLifecycleEvent plus customer.lifecycle_changed.v1 and assignDefaultFreeTrack.v1 command intent. Nonmutating resolve/replay emits no duplicate source effect. Owner evidence JSON is closed under contracts/database-review/owner-mutation-evidence.v1.schema.json; private text/credentials never copied wholesale.
objects_and_invariants.positive_test: Commit source/history/receipt/outbox together; rollback any part leaves none
objects_and_invariants.negative_test: Missing evidence/required intent, foreign owner/revision, forged transaction ID or precommitted reused proof rejects at COMMIT

objects_and_invariants.title: Fencing, reclaim and truthful reservation release
objects_and_invariants.owner: platform mechanism with source semantic receipts
objects_and_invariants.mechanism: Row locking + lease compare-and-swap + deferred effect/receipt checks
objects_and_invariants.exact_requirement: Work claim serializes by work ID; each claim/reclaim strictly increases fence. Completion/effect writes require current fence and lease identity. Inbox/effect commits share source transaction. Reservation quantity > 0. Deadline expiry alone never establishes noncommit; release after unknown requires matching durable fenced_noncommit receipt preventing late source commit. Unknown remains reserved/reconcile-required. Delivery may repeat, business effect may not.
objects_and_invariants.positive_test: Current worker commits once; valid new-fence reclaim resumes after crash; explicit noncommit safely releases
objects_and_invariants.negative_test: Old worker completion/effect, deadline-only release, double claim at same fence or duplicate effect denied

objects_and_invariants.title: Order source/participant and purchased-scope coherence
objects_and_invariants.mechanism: CHECK plus deferred source-family/participant constraint trigger
objects_and_invariants.exact_requirement: Offering source: offeringId nonnull, gigAssignmentId null, seller nonnull, no screening child. Gig source: offeringId null, gigAssignmentId nonnull, seller nonnull, no screening child. Screening source: both marketplace refs null, seller null and exactly one OrderScreeningSource. Self-paid screening subjectUserId equals buyerUserId and its selected Candidate/Professional profile belongs to that User; no sponsored flow. Order/customer/user, Offering seller and accepted Gig winner must match. Buyer/customer required for all new Orders/Booking/holds/locks. Immutable purchase revisions and named purchased units retain price/fees/currency/title/scope/quantity/version; no repricing from current catalog.
objects_and_invariants.positive_test: One coherent Offering, accepted Gig or approved conditional self-paid screening source can be represented
objects_and_invariants.negative_test: Zero/multiple sources, fake screening seller, wrong package/subject/buyer/seller or duplicate Gig conversion rejected

objects_and_invariants.title: Agreement execution and Payment-owned outcomes
objects_and_invariants.mechanism: Immutable revisions + coherent references + unique effects
objects_and_invariants.exact_requirement: Signature/electronic consent/document executionRevisionId belongs to its Agreement and same Order purchase revision. Document hash/object version matches actual immutable bytes and signer role. Never infer signature from legacy URL/hash/cache. PaymentEffect purchaseRevision/order/currency/amount/operation must match its frozen owner instruction and runtime effect identity; payout/ledger/corrections preserve original lineage. Tax liability is an explicit reviewed policy input, not the historical default.
objects_and_invariants.positive_test: Matching execution signature/document or authorized Payment receipt can be retained
objects_and_invariants.negative_test: Cross-agreement document/signature, altered finalized purchase, mismatched effect/currency or unapproved tax default rejected

objects_and_invariants.title: Typed Track selection, Free/paid and UTC usage
objects_and_invariants.mechanism: Subject XOR/coherence triggers, unique current selection and atomic reservations
objects_and_invariants.exact_requirement: Exactly one typed profile FK matches AccountTrack and each profile.userId equals row.userId; plan/grant definition track/value kind matches. TrackBaseSelection unique(userId,track). Free enrollment is provider=none under a free plan, no provider customer/subscription identity. Immutable enrolled policy version; current paid-through selection cannot be overwritten by delayed Free. TrackUsageEvent acceptedAt determines UTC period; counter equals retained usage/corrections, not authoritative reset state. Reservation and consumed source identity unique; unavailable/unknown never allows quota or releases it.
objects_and_invariants.positive_test: Correct Free enrollment replays; current paid selection survives delayed Free; same UTC-period usage survives plan switch
objects_and_invariants.negative_test: Wrong actor-profile/track, multiple current bases, paid downgrade, typed-value mismatch, duplicate usage or destructive reset denied

objects_and_invariants.title: Purchased units, interval exclusivity and provider currentness
objects_and_invariants.mechanism: Deferred coherence + native GiST exclusion + generation checks
objects_and_invariants.exact_requirement: OrderSessionReservation unit belongs to purchase and matching Booking Order; reserved/committed quantity cannot exceed that frozen purchased unit. Select a native GiST exclusion over (professional_profile_id WITH =, tstzrange(starts_at,ends_at,'[)') WITH &&) for lock status active/converted, using btree_gist. Verify and separately authorize that extension before the later scheduling migration; it is not installed by this review or required by F0. Release/expiry is an explicit fenced owner transition, not a clock-only predicate. Authoritative hold relation is BookingSlotLock.bookingHoldId. Booking/Interview successor cannot branch/cycle; parent Application/Organization/Candidate and audiences coherent. CalendarDesiredMapping has exactly one parent and applies only matching parent/audience/desired generation. Video room credentials are not persisted as reusable join URLs.
objects_and_invariants.positive_test: Two nonoverlapping valid locks and matching current provider mapping work
objects_and_invariants.negative_test: Overlapping racing locks, wrong purchased unit, stale callback, cross-Application Interview, branched successor and stale-room credential denied

objects_and_invariants.title: Privacy generations, actual receipts and exact export accounting
objects_and_invariants.mechanism: Typed descriptor uniqueness, receipt coherence and generation/tombstone checks
objects_and_invariants.exact_requirement: Each instruction is unique request/owner/target-kind/source/action/generation and binds exact source/field-map/executor version. Receipt generation and instruction match. retained requires approved legalBasisRef, omitted requires owner reason/accounting; unknown/failed cannot complete request. Export-ready requires all owner accounting, exact immutable Media object version/size/digest and complete manifest bound to same generation. Restore markers reapply erasure/restriction generation before serving restored data. Deadlines originate at statutory request event, not reset by verification.
objects_and_invariants.positive_test: Current completed/retained/omitted accounting forms a truthful nonproduction result; supported exact export bytes match manifest
objects_and_invariants.negative_test: Old-generation completion, accepted-as-completed, missing owner, assumed backup purge or mismatched export bytes rejected

objects_and_invariants.title: Media revision, exact bytes and protected grants
objects_and_invariants.mechanism: Immutable policy/object constraints and typed parent/context joins
objects_and_invariants.exact_requirement: MediaUploadPolicy unique(context,version), activated content/hash immutable; one current applicable revision per context/policy interval. Every attempt has required policy revision and dedicated attempt state. Validation/scan/processing facts bind exact input/output object version/checksum; ready requires qualified mandatory stages and approved metadata scrub. MediaAsset.currentObjectVersionId belongs to same asset. Protected grants bind object/context/source/audience/security generations and allowed operation. CourseVideoAsset.offeringId, when retained, equals courseDetailsId. No Media polymorphic ownerType/ownerId.
objects_and_invariants.positive_test: Exact qualified object/attempt/current context can receive the approved operation
objects_and_invariants.negative_test: Wrong object/version, stale/revoked parent, skipped scan, course mismatch or URL-as-byte-proof rejected

objects_and_invariants.title: Non-authorizing projections, evidence schemas and monetary invariants
objects_and_invariants.mechanism: Field classification, typed evidence schemas and owner-specific invariant triggers
objects_and_invariants.exact_requirement: Compatibility/display/projection fields listed per model cannot authorize a source action. All new required storage identities/constraints live in normalized columns, not JSON. Every Json field is enumerated in database-candidate-json-boundaries.json. Initial F0 accepts only the exact registered evidence/result/outbox shapes; other F0 metadata and JSON-valued entitlements stay null. Deferred nullable fields deny nonnull values and deferred nonnullable fields block their table migration until an exact closed schema is reviewed. Every Json field remains private and requires its exact registered closed schema/version and owner serializer before its owning stage activates; it never supplies actor authority, implicit provider approval, lifecycle success or economic identity. JSON evidence allowed field set is generated from the reviewed per-model schema and excludes raw personal bodies/secrets. Signed points/balance/correction ledgers preserve sign; ordinary prices/quantities and fees obey source policy nonnegative bounds. No invented blanket monetary cap, refund timer or legal period.
objects_and_invariants.positive_test: Authorized owner can append coherent signed correction and rebuild a projection without changing source truth
objects_and_invariants.negative_test: Projection-based permission, arbitrary JSON keys, implicit legal/provider result, malformed price/interval or unsigned invalid ledger correction denied

objects_and_invariants.title: Ops persistence and protected QueueJob view
objects_and_invariants.mechanism: Append-only occurrences; explicit incident transitions; SECURITY INVOKER view
objects_and_invariants.exact_requirement: OpsSystemEvent and OpsIntegrationFailure unique actual occurrence keys; retry observations do not overwrite an occurrence. OpsIncident only open/triaged/mitigated/resolved with authorized explicit reopen history. platform.ops_queue_job is a read-only projection of RuntimeWorkItem/RuntimeAttempt: IDs/state/fence/attempt count/lease timing only; no payload/grant token/credentials. It is not a Prisma table or executable queue. View uses security_invoker=true and current support/service context; no browser grant. Telemetry unavailable cannot deadlock core runtime.
objects_and_invariants.positive_test: Authorized operational read sees minimized real runner state; new incident transition appends event
objects_and_invariants.negative_test: Queue projection writing source/dispatch, hidden payload exposure, duplicate occurrence or automatic business success denied

objects_and_invariants.title: Hiring, discovery and review coherence
objects_and_invariants.mechanism: Current owner source binding and deferred cross-record checks
objects_and_invariants.exact_requirement: Active Organization has an authorized current owner member; removing last owner serializes on Organization and is denied. Organization.ownerUserId is not membership authority. Job Compliance publication proof matches exact Job source revision/rule-set hash; cached complianceStatus never substitutes. Candidate discovery is affirmative opt-in, with current participation/source/privacy generation; rawResumeTextIndexed must be false. Resume parsing only extracts and cannot rank/reject. Review rating obeys approved product scale, no incentive/retaliation policy invented. No-show or provider completion alone causes no money or whole-Order transition.
objects_and_invariants.positive_test: Correct current membership/discovery/Job-source evaluation can be represented
objects_and_invariants.negative_test: Foreign Organization resume/view, last-owner removal, stale compliance, discovery without opt-in or rank-from-parse denied
